findings.issue: Existing renderers could not show code-field boundaries and meanings without treating the code as numerical magnitude.
findings.revision: Add generic codeSegments renderer driven by field labels/values; keep schema meaning in Course Package data and use neutral rawValue rather than an executable-looking code field.

summary: After textbook re-grounding, field semantics, fixed-width zero padding, fresh decode evidence, reverse encoding, and the safe generic codeSegments renderer satisfy the ready gate.
